title: MSS Multi-instrument Trade no 6
author: AlbertHandi
selftext: Today's trade was taken on US500 with the risk of 1% on an RR of 1:0.75. it was done on 5 min time frame (the bot operating time frame). It successful detected liquidity sweep of the previous day high and got ready for a bearish setup which was a shift in market structure with an FVG. Limit was placed on the mid point of the fvg. It was filled and trade was executed with minimal drawdown. It went on to hit the TP and went well beyond that. Here's the journal and trade recap picture.
